tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs | 5+ years E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful/OCC APIs, data-pipeline integration between PIM, ERP and MDM, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and Agile delivery. Proven techno-functional consulting: requirement analysis, user stories, stakeholder coordination and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ruchi Goel’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge commerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. With over five years designing, building and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce, API and integration expertise that can accelerate your SFCC initiatives.

bullets.label: E-commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud platforms handling B2B/B2C catalogs, pricing and order management, directly aligning with SFCC’s commerce requirements.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services and built PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines, mirroring the API-centric integration work essential for SFCC projects.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led Agile Scrum teams, executed CI/CD cycles on Jenkins and Docker, ensuring rapid, reliable releases—key for fast-paced SFCC development.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specs and user stories, guaranteeing that technical solutions meet commercial goals.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Ruchi Goel’s focus on Salesforce Commerce Cloud aligns perfectly with my passion for high-performance e-commerce platforms. I am eager to transfer my proven SAP Commerce Cloud integration and API experience to SFCC, helping your clients achieve seamless, scalable digital commerce while expanding my expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leverage 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud success to drive innovative SFCC solutions for Ruchi Goel’s clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce integration experience. I’m keen to bring my expertise to Ruchi Goel’s SFCC team. Could we discuss how I can add value?
